name: Poker Bull
description: Poker Bull is an Indian Poker variant in which each player is dealt one card and holds it to their forehead without looking, so others can see it. Players ante and bet in a round of poker; highest card at showdown wins the pot (ties split). In the bull variant, highest and lowest cards share the pot.

overview.description: Poker Bull is an Indian Poker variant in which each player is dealt one card and holds it to their forehead without looking, so others can see it. Players ante and bet in a round of poker; highest card at showdown wins the pot (ties split). In the bull variant, highest and lowest cards share the pot.

history.origins: Indian Poker is named after the idea that cards held to the players' heads resemble a Native American headdress or war bonnet; it has nothing to do with India. It is also known as Blind Man's Buff. The basic one-card version is described as presumably the original: players ante, receive one card each face down, hold it to the forehead without looking so others can see it, then a round of poker betting follows; at showdown the highest card wins (or in the bull variant, the highest and lowest cards share the pot).
timeline: 20th–21st century: One-card variant with card on forehead and bull (high-low) variant played in informal settings.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the highest card at showdown among players who did not fold, or in the bull variant by having either the highest or lowest card (high and low share the pot).
rules.gameplay: Players ante and are dealt one card each face down. Without looking, each holds the card to their forehead so all other players can see it. A round of poker betting follows (fold, check, bet, call, raise). After betting, remaining players reveal; highest card wins the pot. Ties split the pot; there is no suit order. In the bull variant, the highest and lowest cards share the pot.
keyRules: One card each held to forehead; players see others' cards but not their own.
Standard poker betting: fold, check, bet, call, raise.
Showdown: highest card wins; ties share the pot; no suit order.
Bull variant: highest and lowest cards share the pot.

scoring.winCondition: Highest card among players who did not fold wins the pot; ties split the pot. Bull variant: highest and lowest cards share the pot.
